blogs.title: Getting Started with TypeScript
blogs.body:
# Why TypeScript?

TypeScript adds **static typing** to JavaScript, catching errors before runtime.

## Benefits
- Better tooling
- Safer refactors
- Self-documenting code

```ts
const greet = (name: string) => `Hello, ${name}`;
```
